title: Cheese
lede: Before Cheese sends a message, opens a task, decides a review or manages members for you, it checks whether that is what you want done. When it isn't sure, it asks you in its reply or in the panel first. Only you can change this page.

ask.title: Confirmation needed
ask.desc: Cheese asks you to confirm these actions every time before taking them.

allow.title: No confirmation needed
allow.desc: Cheese no longer asks you to confirm these actions. It still asks when the target or content doesn't match what you asked for.
allow.hint: For example: answering questions in channels I run

routines.title: Routines
routines.desc: Cheese runs these on a schedule or when something happens, and notifies you of the result. To create or change one, tell Cheese in the panel.

paused.away: Paused: not signed in for a long time

last.asked: Last run: {n} actions waiting for you to confirm

routines.deleteBody: It will no longer run. Its conversations are kept.

recent.title: Recent actions
recent.empty: Cheese hasn't taken any action others can see for you yet.
